description: This file defines the JobRegisterService interface, which declares methods for managing scheduled jobs and scheduler state within the Fineract infrastructure.

classes.name: JobRegisterService
classes.description: Interface for job scheduling operations, including execution, rescheduling, pausing, starting, stopping, and querying the scheduler status.

methods.name: executeJobWithParameters
methods.description: Executes a job identified by jobId with specific parameters given in JSON format.

methods.name: rescheduleJob
methods.description: Reschedules the job identified by jobId.

methods.name: pauseScheduler
methods.description: Pauses the scheduler if it is running.

methods.name: isSchedulerRunning
methods.description: Checks if the scheduler is currently running, returns boolean.

methods.name: stopScheduler
methods.description: Stops the scheduler identified by name.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules a new job using the provided ScheduledJobDetail object.
